items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: And Andrew Anderson was working at the club on wood.

ctx.x: I've got a picture of him. Because he had that club, he was operating that club, and he had a club on wood. He was operating that club on wood. And Andrew Anderson was working at the club on wood. And Andrew Anderson was working at the club on wood. And we was at the club all on the thing. Yeah, well he was tied up with Josie Arlington. And she had a house, you know. She was in that space line. So he was all tied up with that. What was Decatur Street like then? Decatur Street was Wood.
Mm-hm. Decatur Street was Boorman Street. Mm-hm. Boorman Street wasn't no one. Yeah. It wasn't nothing. Decatur Street was everything. All the club was right there on Decatur Street.
